Privacy Policy

Information We Collect. We collect personal information including your name, email address, and health records when you use our services.

Data Retention. We retain your personal data for as long as necessary to provide services and comply with legal obligations.

Your Rights. You have the right to access, correct, and delete your personal information at any time by contacting us.

Privacy Statement

Collection of Information. We collect financial account information and transaction data to process payments securely.

Cookies and Tracking. We use cookies and tracking technologies to analyze usage and personalize your experience.

International Transfers. Your data may be transferred to and processed in countries outside your own.

Customer Privacy Notice

What We Collect. We gather your purchase history, shipping address, and payment details when you shop with us.

Sharing With Third Parties. We may share data with third-party service providers and advertising partners.

Data Deletion. You may request deletion of your account and associated personal data.

Student Privacy Policy

Student Data. We collect student names, grades, and coursework to deliver educational services.

Children Under 13. We comply with COPPA and obtain parental consent before collecting data from children.

Security. We implement reasonable safeguards to protect student information from unauthorized access.

Privacy Policy

Usage Data. We collect information about the shows you watch and your viewing preferences.

Automated Recommendations. We use automated systems and algorithms to recommend content based on your activity.

Opt-Out. You can opt out of personalized recommendations in your account settings.
